sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian forces conducted a unique operation striking the Novorossiysk naval base, the Russian Black Sea Fleet's last main foothold. Russia has stockpiled approximately 6,200 Geran drones for potential massive winter attacks. Widespread drone activity continues across northern, eastern, and southern Ukrainian regions with both reconnaissance and strike UAVs.

points: Ukrainian defense forces executed a unique operation targeting the Russian naval base in Novorossiysk, described as the Black Sea Fleet's last primary stronghold in the Black Sea, demonstrating long-range strike capability against strategic maritime infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/83392)

Ukrainian strikes have completely halted operations at Russia's Orsk refinery in Orenburg region, with the governor confirming repairs to damaged key infrastructure may take up to six months due to sanctioned import equipment, causing 20% of gas stations to close and fuel rationing of 30 liters gasoline and 60 liters diesel per person. (Source: @eRadarrua/105245)

Ukrainian drones struck the Gazprom Neftkhim Salavat petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, one of Russia's largest oil refining and petrochemical facilities with 10 million tons annual capacity, located approximately 1,400 kilometers from the Ukrainian border. (Source: @eRadarrua/105231)

Ukrainian forces continue offensive operations on the Orikhiv direction in Zaporizhzhia region, with fighting reported in Stepnohorsk, southern Primorske, Lukianivske area, and toward Yurkyvka, while Russian forces use FABs against Ukrainian logistics bridges in the Krasnolimansk direction. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)

Ukrainian sappers from the Norwegian NGO Norsk Folkehjelp were killed in a missile strike in Kherson region on June 24, 2026, with Russian sources alleging the organization supports Ukrainian Armed Forces landing preparations in Crimea rather than purely humanitarian work. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32405)

Russian Ministry of Defense claimed capture of Shcherbakyka village in Kharkiv region, though Ukrainian Center for Countering Disinformation confirmed the settlement was liquidated in 1997 with no remaining residents, indicating fabricated territorial claims. (Source: @UkraineNow/83386)

Russian forces have stockpiled over 6,200 Geran kamikaze drones before winter, with typical attacks launching 150-200 drones during stockpiling periods and maximum single attacks reaching approximately 300 drones, while massive attacks could involve 600-1,000 drones simultaneously. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32394)

Russian assault units of the 11th Tank Brigade from the "North" Group of Forces drove the 129th Territorial Defense Battalion out of Vodyanoye village in Olkhovatska rural community, Kharkiv direction, and liberated the settlement. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)

Russian forces struck a fuel depot in Kyiv region using precision-guided weapons and drones, and destroyed bases storing fuel and lubricants, a tanker, a cargo ship carrying military equipment, and a Ukrainian patrol boat in Odesa, Chornomorsk, and Ochakiv according to Russian MoD. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)
Russia returned 261 bodies of fallen Ukrainian soldiers in exchange for 24 Russian military bodies, with war correspondent Alexander Kots reporting the exchange. (Source: @tass_agency/390104)

Russian forces advanced near Privillya in Donetsk region according to DeepState map update, with the mapping project noting unprecedented operational activity levels exceeding even the Kursk operation period. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23733)

In the Krasnolimansk direction, fighting focuses on logistics as Ukrainian forces restore a bridge while Russian forces drop FAB high-explosive aerial bombs on it, with heavy FAB bombing of Druzhkivka destroying shelters with enemy personnel and drone operator stations in apartment buildings. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)

On the Zaporizhzhia front, fighting continues in Stepnohorsk, southern Primorske, Lukianivske area, and toward Yurkyvka, while in Tokmak private homes were damaged by enemy drone attack injuring one resident, with additional civilian injuries in Tymoshivka and Mykhailivka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)

Russian reconnaissance and strike drones operate in Kharkiv region around Bohodukhiv and Shevchenkove areas, with Ukrainian air defense assets engaged to intercept potential target designators for Russian strike systems. (Source: @kpszsu/72620)
A jet-type UAV was observed moving northwest in southern Kharkiv region, indicating continued Russian aerial reconnaissance and potential strike preparation in the sector. (Source: @kpszsu/72581)
Three jet-powered Shahed drones launched from Chernihiv region toward Vyshhorod district in Kyiv region, prompting air defense alerts in the capital's northern approaches. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70176)
Two Banderoil-type jet UAVs targeted Balakliia and Donets from the south, with one Ruska Lozova also reporting drone activity in Kharkiv region. (Source: @eRadarrua/105215)

A probable reconnaissance drone was detected over Horodnia and another over Kholmy in Chernihiv region, while Chernihiv city itself reported very low-flying Banderoil drones forcing sheltering. (Source: @eRadarrua/105240, @eRadarrua/105232)
Jet-powered UAVs moved toward Chernihiv/Kulykivka area from the east, indicating continued Russian aerial pressure on northern Ukrainian regions. (Source: @kpszsu/72605)
A UAV was detected moving toward Stepanivka/Sumy from the north, maintaining pressure on Sumy region's northern approaches. (Source: @kpszsu/72618)

A Shahed drone struck a passenger train in Odesa region, killing the driver and his assistant while the train was heading to a station for passenger evacuation; approximately 340 passengers and crew were evacuated without injuries. (Source: @UkraineNow/83396)

A UAV bypassed Apostolove in Kryvyi Rih district, Dnipropetrovsk region, on a northern course, while a jet UAV passed Ochakiv (Mykolaiv region) heading toward Dobroslav (Odesa region). (Source: @kpszsu/72621)

Barrage munitions of Banderoil type were launched toward Odesa from the Black Sea water area, indicating continued Russian naval-based drone operations against southern Ukrainian ports. (Source: @kpszsu/72611)
A UAV moved toward Vylkove (Odesa region) from the east, while a jet UAV in Ochakiv area (Mykolaiv region) was observed on a variable course. (Source: @kpszsu/72628, @kpszsu/72603)

In Kherson region, serious electricity and water supply problems persist, with Russian forces using FABs to strike rear areas of Ukrainian-held Kherson, destroying a major logistics hub between Cherepakhivka and Stepankivka according to the 18th Combined Arms Army. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)

Russia has stockpiled over 6,200 Geran kamikaze drones before winter, with Ukrainian Defense Intelligence reporting the most massive attacks could involve 600-1,000 drones while typical stockpiling-period attacks launch 150-200 drones with a maximum of approximately 300. (Source: @UkraineNow/83392, @ukr_leaks_eng/32394)

Over the past 24 hours, more than a thousand Ukrainian drones were shot down over Russian regions according to Russian sources, indicating massive Ukrainian drone operations against Russian rear areas. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)

A massive Ukrainian drone attack on Sevastopol during the night caused a complete power outage in the city, while in Rostov region a young woman was injured at a recreation center near Donetsk from drone activity. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417)

Multiple Banderoil-type jet drones and Shaheds operate simultaneously across Kharkiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kyiv, Mykolaiv, Odesa, and Dnipropetrovsk regions, demonstrating coordinated Russian aerial pressure on multiple fronts. (Source: @kpszsu/72620, @kpszsu/72581, @kpszsu/72618, @kpszsu/72605, @kpszsu/72621, @kpszsu/72603, @kpszsu/72628, @kpszsu/72611, @eRadarrua/105215, @eRadarrua/105240, @eRadarrua/105232, @mon1tor_ua/70176)

Ukrainian strikes on Russian strategic energy infrastructure include the Novorossiysk naval base, Orsk refinery (completely halted, 6-month repair estimate), and Salavat petrochemical complex (1,400 km from border), demonstrating extended reach. (Source: @UkraineNow/83392, @eRadarrua/105245, @eRadarrua/105231)

sections.threat_assessment: The operational tempo is escalating with Ukraine demonstrating strategic reach through strikes on Novorossiysk, Orsk, and Salavat — targets 1,400 km from the front. Russia's stockpiling of 6,200+ Geran drones signals preparation for massive winter aerial campaigns potentially involving 600-1,000 drones per wave. Simultaneous multi-axis drone pressure across northern, eastern, and southern fronts indicates Russian intent to overwhelm Ukrainian air defenses while probing for gaps. The fabricated claim of capturing a non-existent village (Shcherbakyka) suggests Russian information operations to manufacture tactical successes. Ukrainian logistics in Kherson face degradation from FAB strikes on rear hubs, while Russian advances near Privillya and Vodyanoye show incremental ground pressure.
sections.regional_response: Poland is actively considering transferring another batch of Patriot missiles to Ukraine within days, influenced by a recent Russian missile incursion into Polish territory, with Deputy Defense Minister Magdalena Sobkowiak-Charniecka confirming the decision is imminent. NATO monitoring of Russian drone production and stockpiling continues as the 6,200 Geran figure represents a significant escalation in long-range strike capacity. The body exchange mechanism (261:24) remains a rare functional humanitarian channel amid escalating kinetic operations. International attention to Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy infrastructure (Orsk, Salavat) may prompt discussions on proportionality and escalation management among Western partners.
sections.intelligence_notes: DeepState mapping reports unprecedented operational activity levels exceeding even the Kursk operation, with enemy advancement confirmed near Privillya. The widespread deployment of Banderoil-type jet drones alongside Shaheds across seven Ukrainian regions suggests Russian doctrinal evolution toward mixed swarm tactics. Ukrainian targeting of export-oriented energy infrastructure (Orsk, Salavat) aims to degrade Russian revenue streams under sanctions pressure. The NATO-reported 1,000+ Ukrainian drones shot down over Russian regions in 24 hours indicates a massive Ukrainian aerial campaign against Russian rear logistics. Russian MoD claims of destroying Ukrainian fuel depots, a tanker, cargo ship, and patrol boat in Odesa/Chornomorsk/Ochakiv require verification but suggest intensified Russian maritime interdiction.
